flows.title: Import contacts via CSV
steps: Open the Command Menu with Cmd+K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Windows), type "import", select Import records, then choose People.
Click Select file and choose your CSV, XLSX, or XLS file, then wait for Twenty to analyze it.
Review the automatic column mappings, fix any that are wrong by picking the right field from the dropdown, and choose "Do not map" for columns you don't want to import.
Click Next Steps; rows with errors are highlighted in yellow, so fix a value by clicking the cell, or click the X to skip a problem row.
Review the import summary and click Confirm to import.

flows.title: Set up a sales pipeline
steps: Go to Settings → Data Model, select Opportunities, click the Stage field, and add, remove, or rename stages to match your process.
Go to Opportunities, click the view dropdown, choose + Add view, name it, click Create, then open Options and select Kanban as the layout.
Open Options → Fields and click the eye icon next to a hidden field, such as Company, Close Date, or Owner, to show it on the cards.
Create an opportunity by clicking + New in the Opportunities view (or the + in a stage column), then drag and drop cards between columns to move them through stages.
